extracted.intended_audience: journalists, investors, media relations professionals and the general public
extracted.subtask_description: A corporate news index page listing Novartis press releases, ad hoc regulatory announcements, statements and feature stories; used by media, investors and stakeholders to find official communications and disclosures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ad hoc releases — SIX Swiss Exchange Article 53 Listing Rules
rubrics_metrics.description: Ad hoc releases are announcements pursuant to SIX Swiss Exchange Article 53 Listing Rules.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Page repeatedly labels certain items as "Ad hoc announcement pursuant to Art. 53 LR" (and German equivalents), indicating these items are formal regulatory disclosures required under SIX Listing Rules. No further procedural details are provided on this page.

rubrics_metrics.name: News categories (types of corporate communications)
rubrics_metrics.description: All; Press releases; Ad hoc releases; Statements; Stories.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The site organizes corporate communications into these categories (press releases, ad hoc releases, statements, stories). The page lists items under these types but does not provide explicit definitions or production guidance for each category.
